name: reconstitution
wording: A session, new or compacted, recovers the design, its decisions, what is open and what is in flight from the concept journal and the ledger of the branch it is on, never from memory or a conversation: it reads the overview of each context its work touches first, the delivered workflow included, then the detail it needs, and gives the operator its read-back before changing anything.
reason: The operator, 2026-10-15: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure; each role is defined by what it receives and hands over, each handover states what it must contain, and established practice is named rather than restated. The read-back is now a handover of its own; work in flight replaces cuts in flight.
